Hi Sarah — great meeting earlier. Quick summary and attached artifacts (Draft_SOW_v1.pdf, Pilot_credit_schedule.xlsx). Key points below so procurement has single doc to review: 

Pilot scope (recommended)
- Duration: 3 months (90 days)
- Workload: non-PHI clinical search + rerank (as discussed)

Credits and metering
- Credits map to token-generation units and embedding units. Generation credits count per 1k generated tokens; embedding credits per 1k embedding vectors. (See attached schedule for mapping.)
- For your estimated 400k gen tokens / 50k embed units, we recommend a 500k gen / 60k embed credit allotment for the pilot to cover spikes.

Platform fee and telemetry
- We will waive the monthly platform fee for the first pilot month. Remaining months are pro-rated if pilot converts early. Telemetry retention for pilot is 90 days by default; we can extend to 180 days for an add-on.

Support tiers and escalation
- Pilot includes Standard support (business hours, ticket SLAs). 24/7 on-call is available as an add-on (Silver tier) at a fixed monthly retainer.
- If you need a dedicated SRE for cutover or initial rollout windows, we can offer an implementation credit toward that (see implementation credit options below).

Billing & SOW triggers
- We include clear language in the SOW: pilot billing uses credit consumption; production billing starts upon (a) formal acceptance date or (b) conversion to a production subscription, whichever comes first. We added a clause to avoid unexpected charge overlap.

Concessions we can offer for NovaHealth (pending approvals)
- One-time implementation credit (authorization required from sales leadership).
- Waive platform fee for pilot month 1, pro-rate month 2 if pilot extends but converts early.

Next steps
- I’ve attached Draft_SOW_v1.pdf and a simple Pilot_credit_schedule.xlsx. Marissa (cc’d) can map SKUs for on-prem packaging and help with the mutual action plan if you want a milestone-based SOW. Neha (cc’d) can approve the implementation credit if procurement needs it in writing.
